passwordReset.subject: Reset your {{brandName}} password
passwordReset.intro: You requested a password reset for your {{brandName}} account.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

invite.subject: You've been invited to {{brandName}}
invite.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your {{brandName}} email address
verifyEmail.intro: Confirm that this is your email address to finish setting up your {{brandName}} account.
verifyEmail.expiry: This link can be used once and expires in 1 hour.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you did not create an account, you can safely ignore this email.

accountCreated.subject: Welcome to {{brandName}}
accountCreated.ignore: If you did not create this account, contact your administrator.

mfaReset.subject: Two-step verification was reset on your {{brandName}} account
mfaReset.intro: An administrator reset two-step verification on your {{brandName}} account. Your authenticator app and passkeys no longer work as a second step.
mfaReset.next: Sign in with your password, then set up two-step verification again in your account's security settings.
mfaReset.ignore: If you did not expect this, contact your administrator.

appMessage.why: You are getting this because you use {{appName}} with {{brandName}}.
appMessage.stop: To stop these emails, switch them off for {{appName}} in your preferences.
